expectation: Membrane/surface ring on a subset of macrophages (CD163+ subset), also some dendritic and endothelial cells. Scattered single cells or clusters in myeloid-rich areas, absent from most lymphoid or tumour cells, with variation between cores.
observed: A: yellow is patchy and varies by core; one core has dense aggregates and others only scattered cells. B/C: mostly empty, with a few faint cells. D: crisp membrane rings on individual cells next to unstained nuclei. E: CD206 lights discrete cell clusters and only a subset of the CD163 field.
why: CD206 marks discrete cells with membrane rings, concentrated in myeloid-rich cores and covering only part of the CD163 population, not a haze following tissue density.
notes: Strong clustered signal in some cores and sparse elsewhere fits macrophage biology. D shows clean membrane rings. In E, CD206 covers only part of the CD163 field, partly overlapping and partly neighbouring it, not tissue-wide haze.
